If stored but expired, it removes the entry and returns `false`.\n- `delete(key)`: removes the entry if stored (regardless of expiry) and returns `true`; otherwise returns `false`.\n- `size`, a getter property: the number of stored entries that are not expired; it never mutates state.\n\nRecency is a strict total order with no ties: inserting a key places it at the most-recently-used position, and each `set` and each successful (unexpired) `get` moves the key there.
